text:
Cass: Urgent — NovaCorp POC import is getting rapid 429s on /v1/embeddings.batch during a bulk load. Demo in 3 hours. Can we triage quick?

Leo: What batch sizes/concurrency and model? Any sample 429 body?

Cass: They said 4 workers, batch_size=768, model=embed-pro, tenant=novacorp-poc. They sent this response: 

```
HTTP/1.1 429 Too Many Requests
{"error":"rate_limit","retry_after_ms":900,"route":"/v1/embeddings.batch","tenant_id":"novacorp-poc","tokens":125400}
```

Ivy: Fixed retry_after 900ms with small client retries will amplify. Quick hypothesis: per-route burst or tenant-level token pressure from large batches. Ask them to pause and run a single-worker test at batch=128.

Cass: Asked — they can run a one-worker test now.

rate-limit-bot: [automated] Override hint: POST /internal/admin/overrides {"tenant_id":"<id>","route":"<route>","tokens_per_min":<n>,"duration_min":<m>} — infra approval needed for immediate bump.

Leo: If one-worker test removes 429s it's quota/concurrency. Short-term options: (A) ask customer to continue with lower concurrency and smaller batches; (B) infra apply a short override (tokens_per_min=300000 for 30m) to finish import.

Mae: Customer prefers we do a short override so demo prep can finish. Approving demo accommodation — log in CRM.

Ivy: Applying override now if you confirm. I'll post override id and schedule auto-revert 10m before end.

Cass: Single-worker test passed — no 429s in 5m. Please apply the override, Ivy.

Ivy: Override applied ov-20260510-03 at 09:12Z: /v1/embeddings.batch tokens_per_min=300000 duration_min=30.

rate-limit-bot: [automated] Override ov-20260510-03 applied for tenant novacorp-poc by Ivy. Scheduled end 09:42Z.

Cass: Told customer to resume at 09:15 with max concurrency=2 and batch_size=256 while we monitor. Also sent quick client patch: exponential backoff (base=300ms, cap=4s) and full jitter.

Leo: Win. Follow-ups: add "preflight checklist" item to ask about batch size + retry patterns before any POC imports. I'll draft a short note for SEs.

Ivy: Monitoring — no further 429s in 30m window. Reverting 09:40Z.

Mae: Logged accommodation in CRM and scheduled technical handoff to review permanent quota if needed.

Cass: Demo prep green. Thanks team. :tada:
